item.summary: Over 1.93 lakh additional houses were approved under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0) during the 10 th meeting of the Central Sanctioning and Monitoring Committee (CSMC), held in New Delhi on 16 th October 2026 under the chairmanship of Shri Satendra Singh, Secretary, Department of Urban Development (DoUD), Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA).
